design: Task-blind H754 write-PCA coordinates, global train RMS scale only. Signed linear encoder and unit-row decoder with learned biases. Scalar chooses8 signed coordinates; block4 chooses2 blocks by squared coordinate norm. Matched parameter count, initialization seed, training minibatch sequence, Adam schedule, and validation checkpoint rule (MSE every250steps including0). Every seed reported.
limitations: Finite-training pilot, not converged. Unit-decoder signed block TopK baseline, not orthonormal-within-block Grassmannian BSF. Equal active dimension but different combinatorial supports. No task examples in fitting. No causal/manifold conclusion from reconstruction.
